path_base: Original research workspace; all paths are relative identifiers, not runtime dependencies.

paper.meaning: Final 2026-10-14 runtime-table LSQN backend per family; new comparisons rerun all requested methods together.

curves.meaning: The LSQN backend used by all four final residual figures.

reference.meaning: Original frozen solver without cached proposals or later operator kernels.

invariants.parameters: H0=I, tau=.1, theta=.5, Armijo sigma=1e-4, backtracking=.5, eta=min(.5,.5*sqrt(||F||2)), max_outer=500, full inner dimension n, tolerance=1e-8, protection/sign correction retained.
invariants.floating_point: These are algebraically equivalent optimizations, not bitwise trajectory equivalence guarantees. BLAS grouping and fused arithmetic can change learning-query and outer-iteration counts.
invariants.timing: Historical runtime table mixes batches and is not a new same-batch ten-method comparison. No archived times are imported into fresh run rankings.

block32_cache: Retain all rank-one inverse updates; dense conversion at 2*rank >= n; Fortran-order dense base with panel size 32 and BLAS3 flush.
Cache proposals through exact rank-one update identities, with actual model refresh before forcing acceptance. No truncation or changed tolerance.
cache_reuse: Cache current-policy matrix; reuse unchanged policies and refresh only changed dense rows; sparse stacked CSR row selection.
Reuse forcing product for singleton active-envelope descent pairing; retain original full pairing otherwise.
native: Reuse first unprojected learning image Jp/||p||.
Use direct CSR matvec, native dense policy-row copying, and direct near-active dense row products when fewer than n/2 rows are selected.
fused_sparse: Include native product reuse and block32 cached proposal.
Direct selected-CSR policy products and cached current-policy direction certificate plus all remaining near-active rows.
Fuse both primal and image reorthogonalization passes via the same BLAS operations; every basis column retained.
native_query: Include selected-row policy products and block32 cached proposal.
Fuse one complete learning query: both reorthogonalization passes, normalization, policy image, protected inverse image, and change=w-Hz.
Keep inverse update, basis append, forcing refresh, direction correction and line search in the original algorithm loop.
The original coordinate breakdown fallback is part of the backend, not a failure-triggered substitution to another implementation.

four_figures.scope: All 96 LSQN records and corresponding curves/times were replaced by the selected block32_cache confirmation batch on 2026-10-11. The 2026-10-16 export only relabels SCB to LSQN and removes title/footer; curves and axes are unchanged.

source_files.difference: Current runner additionally supports the later rejected banded_query candidate; recorded native_query branch and all selected native kernels are unchanged. Embedded historical source snapshot matches recorded hash.

runtime_table.scope: Final runtime overlays update table cells only; they do not replace the four figure traces. All 32 LSQN cells equal the median of their three listed validated raw records.

public_queries.evidence: run_supplement.py official loop calls study.run(mdp,'SCB',30) without cache_proposal override; run_study.py loads the frozen solver whose default is False. Initialization uses reward lower bound on every state including absorbing sink.

provenance_caveats: Queue experiment.py has a later added banded_query branch; the original embedded source snapshot matches its recorded hash and all selected kernels remain hash-identical.

Original native libraries use macOS .dylib paths and a loaded NumPy BLAS ABI. The release provides explicitly prepared platform builds; original wall times are historical identifiers, not promised Linux runtimes.
